display_name: Zero-knob joint three-symbol London-proxy open co-sign fade, intraday flat (multi-instrument v1)
hypothesis: On the multi-instrument Phase-0 package H1 bars for XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD (server_clock_as_stored), if the earliest common intersection bar of each server calendar day with server hour in {7,8,9} shows the same nonzero close-open sign on all three symbols, fading that joint impulse at T* close with fixed ATR SL/TP and same-day flat at hour>=16, under identical risk and Standard STP costs, has no free parameters. Any edge must come from joint co-directional overreaction across gold and the two majors—not from a single-symbol day-open reclaim, prior-day break, or blind hour long. Hours are pure server labels; no London wall-clock claim.

clock_contract.source: Multi-instrument package H1 time column (Vantage MqlRates via ExportInstrumentHistory)
clock_contract.london_open_label_note: Name only: fixed server-hour window {7,8,9}; not claimed London civil time
clock_contract.hours_present_develop_note: Use package develop windows; XAU session ⊂ FX; joint ops on timestamp intersection

rule.coincident_bar_T_star: Per server calendar day D: among timestamps present in the intersection of all three symbols' bars for date D, take the earliest bar with server hour in coincident_hours_server. If none → no signal that day.
rule.cosign: At T*: r_S = close_S - open_S for S in {XAUUSD,EURUSD,GBPUSD}; require all r_S nonzero and sign(r_XAU)=sign(r_EUR)=sign(r_GBP) in {+1,-1}.
rule.entry: If cosign holds: for each symbol enter at close of T* in the opposite direction of cosign (fade). Closed-bar only. All three symbols enter on that signal day.
rule.exit: SL/TP or force flat at close of bar with hour>=flat_hour same day; no overnight

fixed.joint_equity: sum of three independent symbol books (no shared margin)

costs.spread_source: package H1 spread / spread_effective columns as costed simulate
costs.cost_timing: measured at entry, deducted at exit booking

fixed.point_size_notes: Use package symbol meta / research costs conventions per symbol (XAU typically 0.01; FX typically 0.00001)

identical_0_1_knob_rule.note: v1 freezes zero free knobs; any future free knob must be identical across all three symbols (no per-symbol tuning)

window.develop_rule: server_time < holdout_start_server (derived from full H1 package)
window.joint_calendar: timestamp intersection of three symbols; signal T* must exist on all three

joint.primary_note: Cardinality 1: joint primary passer is 0 or 1. Requires all three per-symbol soft + joint soft.

null.k_domain: per_day Uniform{0,1,...,m-1} including identity k=0; SAME k applied to all three symbols
null.algorithm: Align symbols on develop timestamp intersection. For each calendar day with m joint bars: (1) for each symbol compute OHLC increments vs day path refs as in within_day_ohlc_increment_rotate_v1; (2) draw one shared k for that day; (3) rotate each symbol's increments by the same k; (4) rebuild each symbol's continuous OHLC path; (5) re-evaluate coincident T*, cosign, and fades. Timestamps and spreads fixed. Independent k-per-symbol is forbidden.
null.notes: Joint null preserves cross-symbol dependence structure under a shared within-day rotate. base_seed frozen; no seed shopping.

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 only; entry at close of T* when cosign holds; no open-of-T* entry

atr.value_used_at_entry: atr[T*] on signal bar close per symbol

execution_contract.entry: fade cosign at T* close on all three symbols
execution_contract.exit_priority: same-bar SL before TP if both touch after entry; then force flat at hour>=16
